transcript.text: Hello everyone. I have about 18 kilograms of ripe oranges available from my backyard orchard. I understand Rosa is interested in taking some or all of them for her small-batch jam. As is my usual practice, I'd like to hear from each interested party — please state your exact price, quantity, item, and timing terms. Once I've heard from everyone, I'll choose the arrangement with the greater stated value, assuming the quantities and practical terms are workable, and I'll record the exact terms of the deal I accept. Who would like to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My exact proposal is to take all 18 kilograms of oranges, return exactly twelve 250-gram jars of orange marmalade, pay no cash, and collect the oranges on Tuesday at 18:00.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I'd like to share something relevant: I sold comparable 250-gram jars of locally made marmalade for exactly $11 per jar at my market last weekend.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: My exact offer is to pay $100 cash for all 18 kilograms of oranges and collect them on Wednesday at 09:00.
transcript.speaker: A4
